answer: An honest agent finds one person once; a farm finds a hundred, and the vault is a diary of appearances while the terrace never rises to match. Someone real must stand behind each name: Invested lighthouse keeper licence with lighthouse keepers association confirmation insists on it, since a licence keepers renew after lamp audits. Standing behind a name costs a 6-day inspection visit that cannot be delegated or shortened, and the voyage is that the stand-in must appear in person for every name, one at a time.
